metadata.title: RAD manuscript: current figure data, readable analysis and verification
metadata.description: Current Figures 1–7 source tables, actual bounded input examples, readable per-figure transformations, producing-run software and parameter registries, source-verification figures, and validation receipts. Figure 7 contains A–D. Reproduction levels and unresolved scientific/native-artwork dependencies are explicit in docs/validation.md. This draft is for author review and has not been published.
